title: Blinkit Quick Commerce Scraper Input
description: Search Blinkit for location-specific public product, price, stock, rating, and discount data.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: One or more Blinkit product searches. Duplicate product IDs are removed across all queries.

locationName.title: Location label
locationName.description: Label saved with every result, such as Mumbai or Bengaluru.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Delivery-area latitude used for Blinkit's location-specific catalog.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Delivery-area longitude used for Blinkit's location-specific catalog.

brands.title: Brand filter
brands.description: Optional exact brand names. Matching is case-insensitive.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (INR)
minPrice.description: Only save products at or above this price.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (INR)
maxPrice.description: Only save products at or below this price.

maxResults.title: Maximum products
maxResults.description: Maximum unique products saved across the complete run.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Maximum Blinkit result payloads processed for each search query.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: India residential proxies are recommended for regional inventory and pricing.
